layout_rules: Keep center visual area open; no dense card wall.
No daily challenge, level, coins, VIP, shop, tasks.
Leaderboard can be hidden/disabled until Batch5, but visual slot may be reserved.
Use approved bright sky/city background and blue-yellow toy-plastic component language.
Object gallery and prop gallery are separate planned entries; show them in Batch 3 and ranking in Batch 5. Home settings uses the accepted repaired component in the project import manifest.
Do not redesign existing UI. Repair approved-source assets; only necessary missing art may be produced in the same style.

rules: Do not render coins, level, challenge completion, treasure chest, generic star rating.
Death reason is shown only if reliably detected.
New collection appears only when count > 0.
Use 9-slice panel + dynamic text/icons rather than a single baked result image.
Current stars reaching zero OR confirmed large-collapse count reaching the incident threshold ends a run.
Batch 1 only shows implemented real fields and retry; tech score, collection, share and ranking attach in their scheduled batches.
Camera zoom is world-only; HUD and dynamic result text keep their intended size.

review_note: 原始 reusable_ready 仅为用途分组；项目实际采用与修复批准查 BATCH0_IMPORT_MANIFEST、USER_VISUAL_APPROVAL 和 VISUAL_R6。

hud.claw: short cable entering from top; no visible horizontal rail
hud.inventory: two slots vertically arranged at lower left; dynamic item icons remain upright
hud.tower: no automatic wooden separator boards between objects
hud.scope: R6 layout confirmed; static implementation verified within VISUAL_R6; gameplay wiring in Batch 1

background.start: ground-level city, platform physically seated on ground, no prebuilt tower
background.background_input: current camera/view height above start, independent of record peak
background.batch0: presentation preview only; true gameplay wiring in Batch 1
background.coverage: full Canvas, cover and bottom aligned; safe area constrains HUD only
